description: Source-account verification for coding and workflow agents: current Builder integration, MCP setup, verified callbacks, and early-beta verification letters.
rules: For new product integrations, use Builder AI sessions and verify callback results with @reclaimprotocol/client >=0.1.44.
Verification Letters is an early beta; keep its API separate from the authenticated Builder API.
Keep organization credentials and task capability tokens private. A request or redirect is not a verified result.
